statements.status_notes: underscore 1.13.7 is bundled as a static JS asset inside nbclassic 1.3.3, the latest release of the classic Jupyter Notebook UI extension. The fix (underscore 1.13.8) requires a new nbclassic upstream release; no such release is available at this time. The vulnerability is a Denial of Service reachable via the classic notebook UI by a user supplying crafted input. Investigation is ongoing to assess whether a workaround (e.g. disabling nbclassic) is appropriate and to monitor for an upstream fix.

The fix (underscore 1.13.8) requires a new nbclassic upstream release; no such release is available at this time. The vulnerability is a Denial of Service reachable via the classic notebook UI by a user supplying crafted input. Investigation is ongoing to assess whether a workaround (e.g. disabling nbclassic) is appropriate and to monitor for an upstream fix.

underscore is bundled inside nbclassic's static client-side assets at /opt/conda/lib/python3.13/site-packages/nbclassic/static/components/underscore/. nbclassic is a compatibility shim for the legacy Jupyter Notebook UI served under /tree; the default user-facing UI shipped by this image is JupyterLab 4.x (served under /lab) which does not load this bundled underscore. The vulnerable code runs in the user's browser only if they actively navigate to the classic UI, and only with input the user themselves controls (their own notebook content). No server-side code path imports or executes this bundled JavaScript.
